items.headline: $HYPE Jumps 15% as ICE Brings Hyperliquid Perps to US
items.summary: NYSE parent ICE is investing in TradeXYZ to launch regulated, Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures in the U.S. $HYPE surged 15% on the news.

items.headline: $CRV Goes Non-EVM: Curve Finance Launches on Stellar
items.summary: Curve Finance deployed natively on Stellar mainnet, its first launch outside the EVM ecosystem — a big expansion move for $CRV.

items.headline: $FLUID Opens DEX v2 Beta With Custom Debt Ranges
items.summary: Fluid's DEX v2 beta is live on Ethereum with custom collateral and debt ranges. Governance set $50K borrowing caps per asset while pool creation stays restricted.

items.headline: $XMR Privacy Scare: Wagyu Leak Exposes Swap Records
items.summary: Wagyu confirmed a data leak exposing 4,580 orders linking public-chain deposits, $XMR destinations and client IPs — a blow for Monero swap privacy.

items.headline: Polymarket Probes Suspicious Israeli Election Trades
items.summary: Polymarket is investigating suspicious Israeli election trades after some accounts cashed out over $100K. Rules allow wallet bans and law-enforcement referrals.
